name: IPM Growth
decision_note: Described in 2020 as an IPM Group growth fund for Slovak/CEE InfraTech scale-ups with stakes in Matsuko and Tachyum; the Slovak vehicle IPM Growth s.r.o. holds ~EUR 2.1m of financial investments, but no investment, fund event or other activity dated on/after 2024-10-25 was found.

evidence.quote: IPM Growth / IPM Group Bratislava, Slovakia €3 M – €20 M Long‑term Growth equity, Infra‑/Deep‑tech
Growth‑equity strategy addressing scale‑up capital gaps in CEE.
IPM Growth is managed by asset and wealth management company IPM Group and is interested in companies that have an actual influence on society and the environment.

The fund is a response to the lack of capital for local and innovative scaleups with a global approach and is focused on InfraTech companies from industries like: mobility, AI-enabled infrastructure and energy.
Currently, among the fund's investments are Matsuko - a company disturbing the remote communication world and Tachyum - processors provider.

Silicon Valley start-up Tachyum Inc. received an outside investment from IPM Growth, the venture capital division of InfraPartners Management LLP, a multi-asset class fund management and advisory firm.
Bratislava, Slovakia – 20/12/2024 – InoBat announces the finalisation of its investment round Series C, successfully raising €100m in equity.
complemented with significant contributions from SIH (Slovakia’s sovereign wealth fund), Lilium, Bromo Capital, IPM Group and Cielo Capital (InoBat’s founders).

analyst_notes: Identity: ORSR extract https://www.orsr.sk/vypis.asp?ID=450600&SID=3&P=0 (windows-1250, not quoted): IPM Growth s.r.o., IČO 52 151 573, registered 04.01.2019, seat Dolná 5, Banská Bystrica; shareholders IPM Group Holdings Limited (London, UK company no. 11719671; EUR 11,250 of EUR 15,000), Global Connect Corporation SK s. r. o. (IČO 46830243) and MaViL, s.r.o. (IČO 52188191); managing directors Marián Boček and Ing. Adrian Vyčítal; licences: property rental, trade, intermediation, business consulting (SK NACE 70220). Not on the NBS register export of 2026-10-24 (the related IPM Avanea Eco Management a.s. / IPM Avanea Eco s.r.o. are registered AIF manager/fund there and are screened by another analyst). RÚZ micro accounts 2025 (statement 7120286, structured data): total assets EUR 2,122,215, long-term financial assets EUR 2,079,996, zero revenue, equity EUR 1.13m and ~EUR 0.99m liabilities - consistent with a holding of one or a few participations, possibly a group SPV (could be E6 captive), not a demonstrated VC. The Papermark list (D, marketing content) calls it a growth-equity investor with EUR 3-20m rounds but links 'IPM Group' to ipmllp.com, which is InfraPartners Management LLP, a London infrastructure investment adviser - the description is therefore unreliable. No website for IPM Growth was found by direct domain probes, and the session's web-search budget ran out before news searches on IPM Growth could be run. Re-screen if a named portfolio company or fund appears. Reviewer update: the Vestbee list of Slovak VC funds (published 2020-10-08, modified 2024-02-21; class D) describes IPM Growth as managed by IPM Group, focused on InfraTech (mobility, AI-enabled infrastructure, energy) at early-growth/growth stage, with investments in Matsuko and Tachyum (e4-e6) - this supplies I2 at directory level, so the record moves from unverified (E8) to exclude E7 (no dated activity in the window; investment dates unknown, left null). Stage, geography and the EUR 3-20m ticket come only from directories (Papermark e2, Vestbee) and are labelled self_reported; Papermark's link to InfraPartners Management LLP remains doubtful. Tachyum is a Slovak-founded processor company (HQ Las Vegas/Bratislava) - company_country SK is an approximation. [revision 2026-10-25 after review: decision stays exclude E7. (1) InfraPartners correction: the link is NOT spurious - the 2018 Tachyum release calls IPM Growth 'the venture capital division of InfraPartners Management LLP' (e7), so the Papermark link to ipmllp.com (InfraPartners Management LLP, London) is consistent; London may be the real HQ (possible S2 for the Slovak set). The Tachyum investment is dated by that release (Feb 2018; month-only, recorded as 2018-02-01). (2) E6 note: IPM Group contributed to InoBat's EUR 100m Series C closed on 2024-12-20 (e8, e9), inside the window, but InoBat's CEO and co-founder is Marián Boček (e10), who is also a managing director of IPM Growth s.r.o. (ORSR, above), and the reviewer reports InoBat as majority-owned by IPM Holding / Boček (not verified here) - a captive group stake (E6-type), not independent VC activity, so it is not recorded as an IPM Growth investment and does not lift E7. Latest independent deal per CB Insights (reviewer): Hilo EV seed 2022-06-14.]
